title: No No, Wait Wait!
blurb: Consequences outrunning objections by roughly one second. Something irreversible has already begun — the send button pressed, the drop committed to, the sentence spoken aloud in front of exactly the wrong person. This is the sound of somebody trying to recall it a fraction too late. As an edit tool for the point of no return it is close to perfect, because the plea and the disaster overlap rather than following one another. Also useful in daily life, more or less continuously, since most of life turns out to be this.
origin: A viral too-late panic clip for irreversible moments.
